In-text counts agree with what they count: app_context.md:27 'exactly three things' lists three and functional prompt.md:22 says 'the three uses named in the application notes'; constraints prompt.md:5 'the second criterion' is cw_shared_saved_record, which is second; cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic 'fifteen' = 3 carets x MULTI; cw_dynamic_code_refused 'five' matches the five forms in security.md:5; cw_focus_returns_to_code 'five actions' matches ui.md:17; cw_narrow_width_usable 'five areas' lists five; 'five-second' budget in behaviour.md:5 matches the 'original five seconds' and 'five-second budget' criteria; ready-made editor markers in cw_custom_document_surface map one-to-one onto the editors named in ui.md:3; 390 px in ui.md:17 matches '390 by 844'. Product name is spelled Colderwater in task.toml, all prompts, app_context.md, server.js and package.json. Actual-run support: the scripted golden run launched the app with the same env -i set (PORT=3000, DB_PATH=/app/app.db, NODE_PATH, uid 65534, cwd /tmp) after solve.sh and all 3 gate, 43 functional and 6 polish checks returned true with one real process restart, so the port, entry, database and install path facts hold in execution; this is not a configured judge run on these bytes. NOTES (not defects in this row): (1) behaviour.md:11 promises the library update 'within about five seconds' while cw_live_library_update and cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft allow 'up to ten seconds'; the criterion is more lenient than the brief, so no conforming app is penalised, and the golden polls every 2000 ms (src/app.tsx:139). (2) server.js:8 also honours an undocumented SQLITE_PATH after DB_PATH; the harness never sets it.
